claude_only.name: Which system of record holds the authoritative identifier for this occurrence, and under what identifier scheme was it issued?
What combination of attributes decides that two incoming records denote the same occurrence rather than two distinct occurrences?
When no master-system identifier exists, is a governed IRI or a locally minted UUID or ULID used, and which authority mints it?
Under what conditions may the identifier be superseded, and how does a consumer resolve an old identifier to the current record?
What criterion delimits this happening from the surrounding continuum of activity, and who applied it?
Is the occurrence recorded as an instant with no interior or as an extended process with internal constituent parts?
How is the record repaired when one recorded occurrence turns out to be two, or two turn out to be one?
Which type code or codes classify this occurrence, and from which governed scheme and version do they come?
May an occurrence carry more than one type, and how are conflicting or overlapping types reconciled?
Which body governs the type vocabulary, and what is the procedure for adding or retiring a code value?
To which external event vocabularies is each local type mapped, and is the mapping exact, broader or narrower?
What is the current status of this occurrence record, and does that status describe the happening or the record?
Which status transitions are permitted, which are terminal, and who is authorised to make each transition?
When the record asserts that the happening did not occur, what evidence and reason support that negative assertion?
How is schedule state such as cancelled, postponed or rescheduled kept distinct from the assertion that the happening occurred?
Is the event time expressed as an instant, a bounded interval, or a duration anchored at one end?
How is an occurrence that has begun but not ended, or whose end is unknown, distinguished from one with a known end?
Where the boundaries are inherently fuzzy, which outer and inner bounds are asserted for the beginning and the end?
Which temporal reference system is the event time expressed in, and is it declared explicitly rather than assumed to be Gregorian and UTC?
What UTC offset was in effect at the place of the occurrence, and is the IANA time zone name recorded in addition to that offset?
How are ordinal, relative, geologic or non-Gregorian times conveyed to consumers that expect a civil timestamp?
To what precision is the event time actually known, as distinct from the precision at which it happens to be serialised?
Is the time asserted as uncertain, approximate, both, or partly unspecified, and to which components does the qualification apply?
How must a consumer treat an imprecise or qualified time value when ordering, filtering or joining occurrences?
Which distinct times are recorded for this occurrence, and which clock produced each of them?
Where the record carries an observation, does the phenomenon time differ from the time the observing act completed, and by how much?
Which of the recorded times governs retention clocks, query windows and completeness watermarks?
How is a record ingested long after the fact distinguished from one captured in near real time?
When two occurrences carry the same timestamp, what deterministic rule establishes their order?
Which qualitative interval relations between this occurrence and others are asserted rather than computed from timestamps?
What is known about the clock that produced the timestamp, and what protects the record against back-dating?
Which identified place does this occurrence reference, and in which external register does that identity live?
Does the record distinguish the precise point of capture from the wider business or organisational location, and how are both used?
At what granularity is the place asserted, and is that granularity a limit of knowledge or a deliberate generalisation?
How is a place that is unknown, inapplicable or withheld distinguished from one that was simply not captured?
In which serialisation is the geometry expressed, and which coordinate reference system URI governs its coordinates?
What positional accuracy is claimed for the geometry, and what produced that claim?
Has the geometry been coarsened, offset or clipped before disclosure, and is the original retained under restriction?
Did the occurrence take place in physical space, in a virtual environment, or in both simultaneously?
How is the virtual location identified so that two occurrences in the same environment can be recognised as co-located?
What producer context does the record declare, and is it a substitute for the physical place or an addition to it?
Which jurisdiction governs this occurrence, and is it derived from the physical place or asserted independently?
Which parties and objects are recorded as taking part, and by which external identifiers are they referenced?
Which participant is the subject or feature of interest of the occurrence, as distinct from the others involved?
Does this occurrence type require at least one participant, and is an occurrence with no identified participant valid?
How is a participant recorded when their identity is unknown, pseudonymous or deliberately not resolved?
In what capacity did each participant take part, and from which governed role vocabulary is that capacity drawn?
On whose behalf did a participant act, and how far back does the recorded delegation chain reach?
Was the participant physically or virtually present, represented, or recorded as involved without being present?
Which recorded participation facts stop short of asserting intent or responsibility, and where does that assertion belong instead?
Which entities did the occurrence use as inputs and which did it generate, and are those sets asserted to be complete?
In what quantities were entities consumed or produced, and in which units and measurement scale?
What state or disposition of an affected entity changed as a result of the occurrence?
When inputs and outputs are recorded by separate occurrences, what identifier links them into one transformation?
Of which larger occurrence or episode is this occurrence a part, and is the parent's membership asserted to be exhaustive?
May one occurrence belong to more than one episode or aggregate at the same time, and how are competing groupings reconciled?
Is the temporal span of the aggregate asserted independently or derived from its members, and what happens when a member is added or retracted?
Is this occurrence an instance of a recurring series, and how is the series identity kept distinct from the instance identity?
What kind of influence is asserted between these occurrences — full causation, contribution, enablement, or mere information flow?
Who asserted this causal link, on what basis, and at what time?
What confidence is attached to the link, on what scale, and what would falsify it?
What constraints prevent cycles and temporally impossible causation among asserted links?
Which business process step does this occurrence represent, and from which governed vocabulary is that step drawn?
What business or physical disposition results from the occurrence, and does it persist until another occurrence changes it?
Which business transactions, orders or cases does the occurrence relate to, and in what role?
What recorded reason or motivating circumstance is asserted for the occurrence, and is it a fact or an interpretation?
Who supplied the account from which this occurrence was recorded, and when did they supply it?
Is the account first-hand, reported by a proxy, or derived from another record, and is that standing recorded explicitly?
What intermediaries stand between the happening and this record, and is the chain complete?
What is known about the reliability or accreditation of each source, and where is that judgement recorded?
What evidence artifacts are attached to this occurrence, and what does each purport to show?
What digest or signature demonstrates that an evidence artifact has not changed since capture, and who computed it?
Who has held or accessed the evidence since capture, and is the custody record gapless?
How is an evidence artifact bound to this occurrence rather than to a similar one, and what happens if the binding is disputed?
What certainty is asserted that the occurrence happened as recorded, and on what defined scale?
How many genuinely independent sources corroborate the occurrence, and what makes them independent?
When two accounts of the same happening disagree, are both retained, and how is the disagreement represented?
What certainty threshold must be met before the occurrence may be published, acted upon or propagated to downstream models?
By what mechanism is an erroneous record repudiated while the erroneous content itself is preserved?
Does a corrective record reuse the identifier of the record it corrects, or take a new one, and how is the relation expressed?
Which changes count as material and require a correction record rather than an additive in-place update?
How does a consumer holding a copy detect that the record has been superseded or repudiated?
Who is authorised to declare this record in error or to file a corrective record, and who is not?
What rights does a recorded participant retain over the portion of the record describing their own participation?
How is stewardship transferred when the accountable party dissolves, merges or hands over the register?
What is the default visibility of this occurrence, and which party decides that default?
How does a participant grant or withhold disclosure of their own participation without affecting the rest of the record?
Under what conditions may participant withholding be overridden, and who authorises the override?
Which named projections of this occurrence may be published, and what does each deliberately omit?
How long is this occurrence retained, from which recorded time does that period run, and on what basis was it set?
When an erasure obligation applies, which elements are removed and which survive so that the occurrence's existence and identifier remain intact?
Which exceptions — legal hold, legal claims, public-interest archiving, research or statistics, legal obligation — justify continued retention here?
What evidences that a retention decision was actually executed against both the record and its evidence artifacts?
To which external vocabularies and versions is this model aligned, and is each alignment exact, broader or narrower?
What evidence supports any claim of conformance, as opposed to a claim of alignment?
Which conflicts between aligned standards are recorded, and how must an implementer choose between them?
Who maintains each mapping, and how often is it re-verified against the upstream standard?
Which envelope carries the occurrence in transit, and which envelope attributes are projections of model elements rather than new facts?
On what rule may a receiver treat two deliveries as the same occurrence, and what must it never treat as a duplicate?
How is a correction propagated to recipients that already consumed the erroneous record?
How does a consumer determine that it has received all occurrences up to a given point, and how are gaps declared?

grok_only.name: What authoritative master-system identifier uniquely denotes this occurrence within the producing registrar, and which system assigned it?
Does a governed global identifier or IRI exist for this occurrence, and how does it relate to the master-system identifier?
Which producer source scope plus identifier pair is treated as duplicate, and may a later retransmission reuse that pair?
Which appellations, including dates or calendar labels, are names rather than identifiers and must not be used as the occurrence primary key?
What is the primary kind of this happening, in which scheme, and is it an agentive activity or a non-agentive process?
If used in a visibility or custody setting, what technical event type, business step and disposition apply?
Which additional types from schema.org, CIDOC, FHIR or a reverse-DNS CloudEvents type should be recorded for routing and search without claiming full conformance?
What short summary distinguishes this occurrence from similar happenings, and in which language?
Which entities, works or topics is the occurrence about or did it feature, without treating those as participants?
What disambiguating description is required when name and type are insufficient to separate this particular from another of the same kind?
Is the happening an instant, a proper interval, an ongoing interval, or only a fuzzy outer bound, and what are the begin and end if known?
What inner (ongoing throughout) and outer (at some time within) bounds, and which begin/end qualifications, express uncertainty of the phenomenal time-span?
What duration is asserted, in which unit or ISO 8601 duration literal, and is it derived from bounds or independently observed?
Which Allen or CIDOC temporal primitives relate this occurrence to other temporal entities (meets, overlaps, during, starts-before, ends-before)?
When did the occurrence happen, as an RFC 3339 timestamp with seconds and explicit offset or Z, or why is event time unknown?
When was the occurrence first observed or the record ingested, and which clock or producer algorithm supplied that instant?
Is the recorded time the actual occurrence time, a consistent producer fallback, or an unknown-offset local time using the RFC 3339 -00:00 convention?
Which temporal reference system, calendar or ordinal scale positions this occurrence?
What is the coarsest temporal unit that the position actually supports (year, day, second, geologic stage)?
If Gregorian RFC 3339 is inapplicable, what numeric or nominal position is used and how is it mapped for ordering?
Where did the occurrence take place, at what granularity, and which location-sibling identifier or relative frame is used?
Was attendance offline, online or mixed, and what virtual location URI applies if any?
For observed object events, what is the read point versus the business location, and may they differ?
If place is unknown, unknowable or classified, what placeholder and disclosure constraint apply?
Which actors participated, which persistent items were merely present, and which objects were used or generated?
Is there a subject on or for whom the happening was performed, and is that subject distinct from the performer?
Is this a non-agentive happening with no participant, and what evidence still documents it?
For visibility events, which instance or class-level object identifiers, parent-child aggregations or transformation inputs and outputs are in scope?
In what role did each party act, from which scheme, and is that role organizer, performer, attendee, witness, registrar or another capacity?
Did the party act on behalf of another agent, under which plan or mandate?
Was the party physically present, virtually present, represented, or only associated after the fact?
What kind of link is asserted (caused, contributed, influenced, motivated, continued, informed, derived, generated, used, transformed) and between which ends?
Who asserted the link, when, at what confidence, and on which source accounts?
Is the link causal or merely temporal overlap or co-location, and which test forbids treating overlap as cause?
Did the happening destroy, produce or transform persistent identities, and which input and output identities result?
Which member occurrences compose this episode, and which parent does this occurrence form part of?
Is this a series, a scheduled recurrence template, or a single instance, and are instance start and end forbidden because a Schedule carries them?
Which plan, order or request does this occurrence fulfill in whole or in part?
If objects were packed or unpacked, what parent identifier, children and ADD/DELETE/OBSERVE action apply?
Who reported this account, when, and is it a primary source-of-truth record or a secondary report?
What reliability and certainty are assigned to this account, and which independent accounts corroborate or contradict it?
Which sensor reading, witness statement, product, trace or document is the primary source entity, and was the narrative quoted or revised from it?
Which facts must remain in encrypted or restricted event data rather than inspectable context attributes?
What is the scheduled-event status, the process status, and the record status, and which plane is authoritative for this instance?
If the activity was not done, aborted, cancelled, postponed or entered in error, what statusReason applies and which previousStartDate values exist?
Was this record amended, and which prior revision, invalidating activity and timestamps apply?
Does this visibility event commission, observe or decommission the object identities it lists?
Under what authority was this account recorded, and which agent is attributed for the record versus associated with the activity?
Which participation facts are public, grant-restricted or omitted, and which grants authorize a personal timeline versus a public chronicle?
What lawful or safety exception overrides default non-disclosure, and how is that exception audited?
What retention class applies to the occurrence record versus participation facts, and until when is each retained?
Is the record under legal hold, and which authority forbids deletion or amendment?
If a participant requests erasure, is participation redacted, the personal timeline suppressed, or a tombstone left for citers?
Which external event classes is this occurrence aligned to, and is conformance actually claimed with evidence?
Which known conflicts apply (scheduled-versus-occurred, required subject, agentive-only, envelope-versus-occurrence, process-versus-event)?
Which sibling models (act, encounter, location, person, organization, situation, phenomenon, schedule, audit, access grant, supply-chain trace) are referenced rather than duplicated?

requirements: Resolve every provider-only bundle, layer and finding against primary evidence.
Resolve the model boundary and entry kind before accepting structure.
Verify live URLs and version pins for all accepted sources.
Record every rejected and deferred node with a reason.
Do not publish while any critical conflict remains unresolved.
